channel.title: Wallora product feed
channel.description: Wallora is a gamified designer wallpaper store. Shop peel-and-stick and non-woven wallpaper in original patterns — botanical, geometric, coastal, art deco and kids' designs — earn XP, unlock badges and level up for member discounts.

item.g:title: Monstera Hush Wallpaper — Peel & Stick
item.g:description: Oversized monstera leaves in soft sage on warm linen. Drawn from a sketchbook kept in a Lisbon greenhouse, Monstera Hush scales the classic tropical leaf up to almost life-size and quietens it with a sage-on-linen palette. A single terracotta stem is hidden in every repeat — find it and you'll never unsee it.
